dimensions.assessment: Affects commercial aviation manufacturers, airlines, the Federal Aviation Administration, and communities beneath flight paths exposed to potential noise and regulatory shifts.
dimensions.evidence: Administrator of the Federal Aviation Administration shall issue or revise such regulations... to allow for the operation of civil aircraft... at a Mach number greater than 1

dimensions.assessment: Changes federal aviation rules to permit land-based supersonic flight under strict sonic boom conditions and establishes binding aircraft noise standards.
dimensions.evidence: Administrator shall issue a final rule establishing noise standards... requiring civil aircraft granted authority... not to exceed the most recent takeoff and landing noise levels

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state or imply specific federal spending, revenue, or economic effects.
Directs substantive amendments to federal aviation regulations (specifically parts of title 14, Code of Federal Regulations).
dimensions.evidence: Administrator of the Federal Aviation Administration shall issue or revise such regulations, such as section 91.817 of part 14, Code of Federal Regulations

dimensions.assessment: Imposes permanent regulatory changes with recurring periodic reviews of noise standards.
dimensions.evidence: further specify a process for periodic review and update of the rule to reflect future advances in aircraft noise reduction technology

missing_information: Economic impact estimates on the aviation industry or administrative costs for the FAA.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs the FAA to issue regulations permitting civil supersonic flights over land without special authorization, provided no sonic boom reaches the ground, and mandates new takeoff and landing noise standards.
